title: Fixed Overhead Head and Paired Basin Wash Station
description: One newly authored complete static dual-level wash-station exterior. A full grounded flange supports one continuous tall round riser with a forward overhead return and a thick downward-open head. A separate complete waist-height empty basin has a real deep inner floor and broad round lip, carried by a rooted side arm and diagonal brace. Two whole bent outlet stems rise together above the basin into paired inward blunt heads. A full long pull rod ends in one genuinely open triangular handle, while a lower fixed lever and footpad and a small blank side paddle complete the one connected exterior. No old beach shower column or boxed drinking fountain geometry is imported; the common two-level arrangement and controls are newly authored. Three opaque materials, one prop zero scenes. Dry fixed visual art only: no water, internal supply/drainage network, spray or flow performance, emergency-use capability, decontamination, health/hygiene, human suitability, instructions, installation, certification or safety claim. Rigging animation and interaction not made.
